name: [Sigma] Suspicious Double Extension Executable Launched From User Writable Path
description:
Detects execution of a binary whose filename ends in a document, archive, or source code
extension followed by .exe, from a user-writable location such as Temp, Downloads, or
C:\Users\Public. The observed cluster ships as composer.php.exe and composer.dat.exe,
imitating a Composer artefact so a developer double-clicking it believes they are opening
a PHP or data file.

Converted from the Sigma rule 'proc_creation_win_double_extension_exec_user_writable.yml' (Sigma id fc5cd64c-4e5f-46f3-b402-557f3128c842, author CTI Team, 2026-08-17).
author: CTI Team (Sigma)
Converted with pySigma 1.5.0 / ecs_windows
note:
Converted from Sigma. Original detection logic:

```
proc_creation_win_double_extension_exec_user_writable.yml
sigma id: fc5cd64c-4e5f-46f3-b402-557f3128c842
```

Requires Windows process_creation telemetry (Elastic Defend, Agent-shipped Sysmon, or Security 4688 with command-line auditing).
false_positives: Self-extracting archives and installers that legitimately embed a data extension in the filename, for example a vendor package named with an internal build identifier.
Developer build output where a toolchain names artefacts after their source file, which is plausible on a build agent or engineering workstation.
query: (process.executable.caseless:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*)) AND (process.executable.caseless:(*.php.exe OR *.dat.exe OR *.pdf.exe OR *.doc.exe OR *.docx.exe OR *.xls.exe OR *.xlsx.exe OR *.ppt.exe OR *.pptx.exe OR *.rtf.exe OR *.txt.exe OR *.csv.exe OR *.json.exe OR *.xml.exe OR *.log.exe OR *.jpg.exe OR *.jpeg.exe OR *.png.exe OR *.gif.exe OR *.svg.exe OR *.zip.exe OR *.rar.exe OR *.7z.exe OR *.iso.exe OR *.js.exe OR *.py.exe OR *.ps1.exe OR *.lock.exe OR *.cfg.exe OR *.ini.exe))
